meaning: Source-reported tensile stress at an explicitly specified percent elongation; not a tangent/secant slope or Young modulus, strength, yield or break stress

field_shape.number: positive decimal string, no upper100 limit
field_shape.evidence: nonempty evidence with condition support from primary property source

presence: Required for the new quantity and forbidden for all existing quantities; schema uses two closed disjoint quantity branches; existing property shapes unchanged
percent_scope: Only target descriptor uses percent, central pressure result still forbids percent; no UNIT_DIMENSIONS change
validation: Positive source-consistent numeric target and percent spelling; source-bound condition evidence. No inferred engineering/log strain, true-stress conversion or recalculation.
uniqueness: Include numerical specified elongation in duplicate-fact signature so100 and200 targets differ even with same stress/locator; formatting does not create new facts
display: Four-language quantity and target labels; show source percent target and scope/evidence with result
native_scope: Only two existing unfilled REF properties; no six-composite extension, new identities/states/grades/sources or changes to existing property objects
implementation_review: Required after concrete code/schema/labels/tests and mapping frozen
